nodes.description: Private mapping _onSaleNum: per-address number of sells executed, incremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping canSale: whitelist flag allowing an address to bypass ensure() checks.
Private _minSale: minimum token amount accepted by condition(), set in init().
Private _maxSale: maximum token amount accepted by condition(), set in init().
Private _saleNum: maximum number of sells allowed per address, set in init().
Trade address whitelisted in ensure(), set by setTradeAddress().
Public mapping balanceOf: token balances mutated in transferFrom, batchSend and constructor.
Public nested mapping allowance: spender approvals mutated in approve/transferFrom and constructor.
Constant decimals = 18 used to scale supply and init thresholds.
Public totalSupply set in the constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Private owner address, set to msg.sender in the constructor and checked for privileged functions.
Constant UNI router address 0x7a25...488D whitelisted in ensure().
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
Internal view ensure(address,address,uint): computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor and applies whitelist / condition checks.
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint): updates allowance, calls ensure/condition, mutates balances and _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve(address,uint): writes allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Internal view condition(address,uint): enforces _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Public payable delegate(address,bytes): owner-only arbitrary delegatecall - critical unsafe operation.
Public owner-only init(uint,uint,uint) that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Public payable owner-only batchSend(address[],uint) that multiplies _value by array length and loops transfers.
Public owner-only setTradeAddress(address) that updates tradeAddress.
Internal pure pairFor: computes the Uniswap CREATE2 pair address from factory and tokens.
Payable constructor(string,string,uint) that sets metadata, mints totalSupply to msg.sender and sets infinite allowance.
msg.sender: untrusted caller used for authorization, allowance and balance accounting.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): executes arbitrary external code in the context of this contract.
